I am 38 years old and I manage this small rented plot of maize in North East Nigeria. Because the land is not mine and I have to save my money for the plots my family owns, I will not buy chemical fertilizer or improved seed for this piece. I will plant maize seed I kept from last year's harvest and put goat manure on it because that costs nothing. My children and I will do all the work ourselves — weeding twice and harvesting by hand — which should take us about twelve days in total over the season. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because the rains should come and I cannot spend that kind of money on rented ground.
